pictures.scene: Guercino, The Return of the Prodigal Son — the father's hands on the son come home and the new robe brought out to him, give thanks to the LORD for He is good, His loving devotion endures forever
pictures.name: pd_guercino_goed

pictures.scene: Giovanni Battista Tiepolo, A Vision of the Trinity appearing to Pope Saint Clement — the Father and the Son enthroned in the clouds above the kneeling pope, give thanks to the God of gods
pictures.name: pd_tiepolo_godengod

pictures.scene: Peter Paul Rubens, The Adoration of the Magi — the kings of the east kneeling with their gold before the child, give thanks to the Lord of lords
pictures.name: pd_rubens_heren

pictures.scene: Raphael, The Miraculous Draught of Fishes — the nets coming up so full that the boats begin to sink and Peter falling at His knees, He alone does great wonders
pictures.name: pd_rafael_wonderen

pictures.scene: Ivan Aivazovsky, Chaos: The Creation of the World — the light breaking over the unformed deep at the first word, by His insight He made the heavens
pictures.name: pd_aivazovsky_hemelen

pictures.scene: Albert Bierstadt, Puget Sound on the Pacific Coast — the long shore standing out of the sea under a great sky, He spread out the earth upon the waters
pictures.name: pd_bierstadt_aarde

pictures.scene: Michelangelo, The Creation of the Sun, Moon and Planets — God sweeping through the heavens with both arms out setting the lights in their places, He made the great lights
pictures.name: pd_michelangelo_lichten

pictures.scene: Vincent van Gogh, The Sower — the sower walking the furrows with the sun standing huge and gold behind him, the sun to rule the day
pictures.name: pd_gogh_zon

pictures.scene: Arkhip Kuindzhi, Moonlit Night on the Dnieper — the moon laying a road of light down the dark river, the moon and stars to govern the night
pictures.name: pd_kuindzhi_maan

pictures.scene: J. M. W. Turner, The Tenth Plague of Egypt — the storm over the city and the mourners gathered in the foreground, He struck down the firstborn of Egypt
pictures.name: pd_turner_eerstgeborene

pictures.scene: Sandro Botticelli, The Trials and Calling of Moses — Moses turning from the flock toward the voice and leading the people out, and brought Israel out from among them
pictures.name: pd_botticelli_uitgeleid

pictures.scene: Anthony van Dyck, The Brazen Serpent — Moses with his arm thrown up toward the standard and the people reaching for it, with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm
pictures.name: pd_vandyck_arm

pictures.scene: Ivan Aivazovsky, The Wave — the sea standing up in one enormous wall of water, He divided the Red Sea in two
pictures.name: pd_aivazovsky_golf

pictures.scene: Agnolo Bronzino, The Crossing of the Red Sea — the people coming up out of the sea bed onto dry ground, and led Israel through the midst
pictures.name: pd_bronzino_midden

pictures.scene: John Martin, The Deluge — the water closing over everything under a black and splitting sky, but swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea
pictures.name: pd_martin_farao

pictures.scene: Jean-Léon Gérôme, Riders Crossing the Desert — the long file of riders strung out across the empty sand, He led His people through the wilderness
pictures.name: pd_gerome_woestijn

pictures.scene: Piero della Francesca, The Battle between Heraclius and Chosroes — the king brought down off his throne among the lances, He struck down great kings
pictures.name: pd_piero_koningen

pictures.scene: Albrecht Altdorfer, The Battle of Alexander at Issus — whole armies wheeling against each other under a burning sky, and slaughtered mighty kings
pictures.name: pd_altdorfer_machtig

pictures.scene: Paolo Uccello, The Battle of San Romano — the lances coming down and the horsemen meeting head on, Sihon king of the Amorites
pictures.name: pd_uccello_sihon

pictures.scene: Francisco de Goya, The Colossus — the giant standing up out of the valley with his fist raised above the fleeing country, and Og king of Bashan
pictures.name: pd_goya_og

pictures.scene: Aelbert Cuyp, River Landscape with Riders — the riders watering their horses in a quiet country of spire and village and wooded hill, and He gave their land as an inheritance
pictures.name: pd_cuyp_erfenis

pictures.scene: Benjamin West, Moses Shown the Promised Land — Moses on the mountain with his hand lifted while the angel shows him the land, a heritage to His servant Israel
pictures.name: pd_west_bezit

pictures.scene: Pontormo, The Visitation — the two poor women meeting in the street and holding one another, He remembered us in our low estate
pictures.name: pd_pontormo_laag

pictures.scene: Giorgione, Judith — the young woman standing calm with the sword still in her hand over the defeated enemy, and freed us from our enemies
pictures.name: pd_giorgione_vijanden

pictures.scene: Jan Brueghel the Elder, The Entry of the Animals into Noah's Ark — horse and lion and cattle and sheep and birds of every kind gathered together in one field, He gives food to every creature
pictures.name: pd_brueghel_voedsel

pictures.scene: Francesco Botticini, The Assumption of the Virgin — Christ enthroned at the top of three great rings of angels with the Alpha and Omega beside Him, give thanks to the God of heaven
pictures.name: pd_botticini_hemel

lines.text: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good.
Give thanks to the God of gods.
Give thanks to the Lord of lords.
By His insight He made the heavens.
He spread out the earth upon the waters.
the sun to rule the day,
the moon and stars to govern the night.
He struck down the firstborn of Egypt
and brought Israel out from among them
with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm.
He divided the Red Sea in two
and led Israel through the midst,
but swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea.
He led His people through the wilderness.
and He gave their land as an inheritance,
a heritage to His servant Israel.
He remembered us in our low estate
and freed us from our enemies.
He gives food to every creature.
Give thanks to the God of heaven!
